about: Background agents of the Concordia project, kept by the agent manager (.claude/skills/agent-manager, tools/agents/agentctl.py). 'requests' is every instruction the user gave about the agent, in order; briefs and CONTEXT.md must agree with them.

requests: Analyse the Forge AI and experiment with the proposed low-risk improvements; build an easy reference for all AI tags and their logic; run small simulations testing fixes to unplayable cards, so the AI plays formerly unplayable cards with effects matching their text (more card plays and wins).
Low speed and low session usage, background work; the main session may pause it during big requests.
Side chat with updates every 6 hours (later: hourly steps, report every 4 hours).
Give it the main session's AI review as materials (AI_RESEARCH.md, AI_FLAGGED_CARDS.md, ai_flagged_cards.html).
Retry failed pushes.
Shrink test decks to 30 cards so flagged cards are drawn more often (if a restriction blocks it, pad with Wastes removed at match start).

Test updates the agents could use are automatically approved, with old versions backed up; AI changes go on a checkbox list for the user's final approval.
analyses: Quality of use at natural density (n001-n003)

triggers.trig_01BNH795z6X1TPBhQ1L41U99: hourly check at :55 (night policy 00-08 ET; main session has priority)

requests: Only purpose: manage agent interactions and subagent productivity. Pinged on every interaction between the main session and the sub agents. Resolve conflicts by keeping sub-agent activity on schedule at night (12 AM-8 AM), unless the main agent is active; then the main agent takes priority.
Make sure both agents have the tools to do their tasks.
Check in with the agents every 4 hours and fix any blocks.
Make sure agents have relevant context; keep an agent management tool that updates agent context along with previous requests.
Whenever an agent sends an analysis request, store the results in an agent-specific file and send them back to that agent as training data.
Automatically approve test updates the agents could use (backups of old versions); generate and keep updated a bullet list of AI changes with checkboxes for final approval.
Set up an agent-coordinator agent; ping it on every interaction with sub agents; night policy 12-8 AM with main-session priority.
